subject: Security pathway evaluation & FedRAMP readiness — next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearbridgehealth.com>, Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Security pathway evaluation & FedRAMP readiness — next steps

Hi Alex / Morgan —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key takeaways from today
- ClearBridge is evaluating Redwood for a clinical-facing routing feature; primary blockers are SOC 2 evidence and FedRAMP readiness for future federal contracts.
- Current compliance posture we heard: SOC 2 Type II in progress (audit started Q4 2026), GDPR applicability for EU patients, and HIPAA implications for PHI handling.
- Interest in ISO 27001 as a mid-term objective to support enterprise procurement.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Please complete the attached vendor intake ("vendor_questionnaire.xlsx") with the security contact details and any additional control notes — this helps our compliance team map evidence quickly.
2) We propose a technical deep dive next week to review data residency, encryption, and network segmentation. Can you confirm 60 mins availability on Tue/Wed?
3) Internally we'll pull together the SOC 2 evidence index and a suggested ISO/SOC expansion timeline.

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx, redwood-compliance-summary.pdf (high-level controls + timeline)

If helpful I can also loop in our compliance lead for a short intro before the deep dive.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform for LLMs

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@clearbridgehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security pathway evaluation & FedRAMP readiness — next steps

Thanks Stephanie — good summary. Attaching our initial responses to the vendor intake and a short list of clarifying questions. A couple points up front: 

- Our SOC 2: We completed our SOC 2 Type II in 2025 for our platform services; however our clinical routing proof-of-concept will expand the scope. We flagged the audit team and will need to understand how Redwood's control set maps to our in-scope systems.
- Encryption: We require AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit; can you confirm your default KMS options and whether we can bring our customer-managed keys?
- FedRAMP: this is exploratory; timeline is multi-quarter. We want to understand Redwood's roadmap and fallback (Dedicated / Private) options.

Attached: clearbridge-vendor-responses.xlsx.

We can do the technical deep dive on Wed 3/17 at 10:00 AM PT — tentative for Alex, Morgan, and our security engineer (Jordan Park).

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Security pathway evaluation & FedRAMP readiness — next steps

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding ClearBridge's responses (attached). Quick internal plan so we don't lose time: 

1) Marissa: can you pull the SOC 2 evidence pack (bridge mapping + recent Type II report excerpt) and the control narratives for encryption/networking? We should aim to produce an evidence index (redwood-evidence-index.csv) and control narrative bundle by Friday 3/19.
2) Vivek: please confirm who on the product/infra side can join the Wed technical deep dive (Alex requested Jordan Park, we'll need someone for KMS and VPC architecture). Also, we should draft a short note on Dedicated vs Private deployment options for FedRAMP-path customers.
3) I'll coordinate and send a short agenda for Wed's deep dive and circulate the completed vendor intake back to the ClearBridge security team.

Risks / asks:
- Need to validate whether we can support BYOK (customer-managed keys) for this account — if not, we should document compensating controls.
- If ClearBridge wants SOC scope expansion, procurement may want a tentative timeline; let's avoid committing hard dates but provide an SLO-style plan.

Attachments: clearbridge-vendor-responses.xlsx (from Alex)

Thanks —

Stephanie
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearbridgehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security pathway evaluation & FedRAMP readiness — next steps

Stephanie — thanks for the coordination and Marissa / Vivek for jumping in. Wed's 10:00 AM PT slot worked well; our team expects a 60-minute session with the following agenda:

- 0–10m: Introductions & scope confirmation (ClearBridge security + Redwood compliance)
- 10–30m: Data flow and residency (how PHI moves through Redwood, what is cached)
- 30–45m: Key management and encryption options (BYOK, KMS vendors)
- 45–60m: Next steps and procurement timeline (SOC scope, ISO interest, FedRAMP exploration)

Attendees from our side: Alex Turner (prod lead), Jordan Park (security engineer), me (program lead). Please confirm Redwood attendees and share a short meeting invite with dial-in and a list of artifacts we should review beforehand.

Also: can you confirm the exact SOC 2 Type II coverage (start/end dates and service carve-outs) and the latest ISO work plan if available? Those will help our procurement team.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Morgan Lee
Program Lead, Security & Compliance | ClearBridge Health
morgan.lee@clearbridgehealth.com | (202) 555-0147
